story.text: Now the wolf was very cross. He climbed on the {ROOF} to come down the {CHIMNEY}. But the little pig hung a big {POT} of {WATER} over the {FIRE}. Down came the wolf, splash, into the hot water! He ran off howling, and never came back, and the three little pigs lived {HAPPILY} ever after.
story.caption: He hung on the pot full of water
